data.description: Project memory has independent retention and startup budgets. Lifecycle startup supplies the complete protocol and at most 2,000 Unicode characters of current summary; oversized summaries are omitted whole with an explicit retrieval instruction, and historical notes are never injected. Explicit get_memory returns the summary/protocol and bounded retained history filtered by literal case-insensitive query, exact runId and taskId; includeSuperseded retrieves resolved notes with their summary version. Only an authorized coordinator replaces the canonical summary and atomically resolves exact reviewed supersededNoteIds under expectedVersion; concurrent appended notes remain active. New notes are complete important handovers of at most 1,000 characters; routine logs are excluded. Retention and replay semantics remain bounded and versioned.
data.name: Project Memory API
data.technology: MCP tools, SQL, append-only notes, versioned compaction
